item.title: Prompt Security’s AI Security Predictions for 2026
item.description:
Author: Prompt Security Team
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Cybersecurity", "AI Governance", "Identity and Access Management", "Privacy and Data Protection"]
Summary:
  • AI-driven cyber threats will become more sophisticated by 2026.
  • AI-powered defense systems will improve threat detection and response.
  • New AI security governance and regulations will emerge.
  • Demand for AI security talent will increase significantly.
  • AI will enhance identity management and privacy protection.
  • AI tools will aid in incident response and digital forensics.
